SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT r.review_idx, r.role FROM ( SELECT review_coach_idx AS review_idx, content, 'COACH' AS role FROM review_coach UNION ALL SELECT review_class_idx AS review_idx, content, 'CLASS' AS role FROM review_class ) r JOIN ( SELECT keyword_name FROM keyword ) k ON r.content LIKE '%' || k.keyword_name || '%' GROUP BY r.review_idx, r.role )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qna q JOIN users u ON q.user_idx = u.user_idx LEFT JOIN qna_a a ON q.qna_idx = a.qna_idx WHERE a.qna_a_idx IS NULL AND (u.user_type = 'COACH' OR u.user_type = 'COMPANY')
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN USER_TYPE = 'COACH' THEN 1 END) AS coachCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN USER_TYPE = 'COMPANY' THEN 1 END) AS companyCount FROM USERS WHERE STATUS != 'INACTIVE' AND USER_TYPE != 'ADMIN'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT mf.minor_field_nm, COUNT(ci.coach_idx) AS interest_count FROM coach_interest ci JOIN minor_field mf ON ci.minor_field_idx = mf.minor_field_idx GROUP BY mf.minor_field_idx, mf.minor_field_nm ORDER BY interest_count DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 2

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.MATCH_IDX) AS "Total", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.IS_CHAT = 'Y' AND (m.IS_MATCH = 'N' OR m.IS_MATCH IS NULL) THEN m.MATCH_IDX END) AS "채팅중", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.IS_MATCH = 'Y' AND a.AGREEMENT_IDX IS NULL THEN m.MATCH_IDX END) AS "매칭완료", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.SCHEDULE_IDX IS NOT NULL THEN m.MATCH_IDX END) AS "일정확정" FROM MATCH m LEFT JOIN AGREEMENT a ON ( (m.USER1_IDX = a.WRITER_IDX AND m.USER2_IDX = a.RECEIVER_IDX) OR (m.USER1_IDX = a.RECEIVER_IDX AND m.USER2_IDX = a.WRITER_IDX) ) LEFT JOIN SCHEDULE s ON a.AGREEMENT_IDX = s.AGREEMENT_IDX

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCH m LEFT JOIN USERS u1 ON m.USER1_IDX = u1.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN USERS u2 ON m.USER2_IDX = u2.USER_IDX
(u1.USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u2.USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM COACH

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM RNUM,a.* FROM( SELECT c.COACH_IDX, c.PHOTO, c.NICKNAME, c.MAIL, NVL(r.AVG_RATING, 0) AS AVG_RATING, c.TOKEN_BALANCE, u.CREATED_AT FROM COACH c JOIN USERS u ON c.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REVIEWEE_IDX, ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1) AS AVG_RATING FROM REVIEW_COACH GROUP BY REVIEWEE_IDX ) r ON c.USER_IDX = r.REVIEWEE_IDX ORDER BY c.COACH_IDX DESC )a )WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{start} and #{end}

SELECT c.USER_IDX, c.COACH_IDX, c.NICKNAME, c.PHOTO, c.VIDEO, c.INTRO, r.RANK_NAME, mf_major.MAJOR_FIELD_CD AS MAJOR_FIELD_NAME, mf_minor.MINOR_FIELD_NM AS MINOR_FIELD_NAME, NVL(rv.AVG_RATING, 0) AS RATING, NVL(rv.REVIEW_COUNT, 0) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM COACH c JOIN USERS u ON c.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN RANK r ON c.POINT_SCORE BETWEEN r.MIN_SCORE AND r.MAX_SCORE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COACH_IDX, MIN(MINOR_FIELD_IDX) as MIN_FIELD_IDX FROM COACH_PROVIDE GROUP BY COACH_IDX ) cp_top ON c.COACH_IDX = cp_top.COACH_IDX LEFT JOIN MINOR_FIELD mf_minor ON cp_top.MIN_FIELD_IDX = mf_minor.MINOR_FIELD_IDX LEFT JOIN MAJOR_FIELD mf_major ON mf_minor.MAJOR_FIELD_IDX = mf_major.MAJOR_FIELD_IDX LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REVIEWEE_IDX, ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1) AS AVG_RATING, COUNT(REVIEW_COACH_IDX) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM REVIEW_COACH GROUP BY REVIEWEE_IDX ) rv ON c.USER_IDX = rv.REVIEWEE_IDX WHERE c.COACH_IDX = #{coach_idx}
SELECT h.TAGS FROM HASHTAG h JOIN USER_HASHTAG uh ON h.HASHTAG_IDX = uh.HASHTAG_IDX JOIN COACH c ON uh.USER_IDX = c.USER_IDX WHERE c.COACH_IDX = #{coach_idx}
